newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed weaker against the dollar on Friday following the U.S. unit's gains in Europe, dealers said.
The forint finished at 180.30/40 against the dollar, down from its opening of 180.09/13 but trade remained light throughout the trading session.
"There was little activity today," said Jozsef Bodor of WestLB Hungaria.
The Hungarian unit remained pinned to the central bank's resistance level (bid) in the absence of domestic market-moving factors, traders added.
The forint floats against the central bank's currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar.
The NBH fixed the forint at 180.26 to one dollar, compared with 179.84 on Thursday.
